title: Jewels of the Oracle
overview:
The legacy of an enlightened and extraordinary civilization, the domain of the Oracle awaits you. Use all your skills of logic and reason to rise to the challenge of the ancients and unlock the doors to the mysterious City of Nisus...

Jewels of the Oracle is a collection of 24 puzzles set in the chambers of an ancient, tomb-like city built around a central well. Move from room to room and work out each puzzle, from logic tests to strategy challenges, often without being told the rules. When you are stuck, the Oracle offers a short, cryptic hint, but the solution is up to you.

- English, French and German text
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
- 1 player
